method: RE-VERIFICATION after gap-fill. Re-read each cited capture in kb/sources/glengoyne/ (incl. NEW: masterofmalt_price, glengoyneshop_price, royalmilewhiskies_price, whiskybase, drinkhacker, whiskynotes, masterofmalt_blog) and re-ran targeted WebSearch (allowed_domains on cited source) to reproduce each datapoint. WebFetch BLOCKED (HTTP 403); reproduction-by-search is the standard.

fields.evidence_quote: bottled at 48% ABV, 70cl (official + Whiskey Wash + Royal Mile, all reproduced live)

matured exclusively in hand-selected sherry casks for a quarter of a century, it's a heavily sherried whisky (Master of Malt live); Whiskybase: 'European Oak Sherry casks (mainly 1st Fill)'. Official page titled 'Sherry Oak'. NO conflation with the 24 White Oak.
Glengoyne house statement: natural colour ... non-chill filtered with no additives or caramel colouring added (glengoyne.com)

fields.field: scores[0] Best Scotch — Whiskey Wash Awards 2025
fields.evidence_quote: Glengoyne 25 Year Old Wins Best Scotch At The Whiskey Wash Awards 2025 ... competing against more than 300 whiskies (live reproduction; corroborated by Master of Malt blog)
The Glengoyne 25-year-old ... has an overall rating of 89.74/100 based on 324 ratings on Whiskybase (whisky/167031, live). European Oak sherry, mainly 1st fill; lowest price £380.

Drinkhacker review (2024-03-10) — sherry-cask 25yo, nutty/leathery, fruitcake/dates, toasted walnuts/coconut husks, milk chocolate, tannic nougat & Christmas spice finish; A- grade. Profile reproduces live; A- captured in prior reproduction WebSearch (snippet did not re-expose the letter this run, but the review and profile reproduce on drinkhacker.com).

aged ... exclusively in sherry casks, bottled at 48% ABV, and priced at $600 (live thewhiskeywash.com). USD, correctly labeled — not confused with the £419-525 GBP retail.

fields.evidence_quote: The average latest price of a Glengoyne 25 Year Old bottle is £250.00 as of January 28, 2026 (live whiskyreturns.com). GBP correctly labeled and correctly attributed to Whisky Returns — NOT confused with the €294 figure that belongs to the 24, nor with the £419-525 GBP retail.

Nose 'dried figs, raisins, rich chocolate, toffee pudding ... leather'; palate 'warm oak, rich fig ... decadent chocolate, hazelnut, butterscotch'; finish 'very long, spicy liquorice' (Whiskey Wash + Royal Mile + official, live). Unambiguously sherry, sherry-distinct from the citrus/vanilla White Oak 24. Currencies clean: £419.90/£499/£525 GBP retail, $600 USD MSRP, £250 GBP secondary — no £/$/€ mix-ups, and the €294 is NOT cross-contaminated from the 24.

pass_rationale: All core fields verify against LIVE reproduction with zero mismatch/unsupported. The three NEW UK prices each reproduce on the cited domain (Master of Malt £419.90, Glengoyne shop £499.00, Royal Mile £525.00), Whiskybase 89.74/100 (324 ratings, whisky/167031) reproduces, Drinkhacker A- review reproduces, and WhiskyNotes gives a 3rd named review. No 24-vs-25 conflation (sherry vs white oak kept distinct) and no currency mix-ups: GBP retail £419-525, USD MSRP $600, GBP secondary £250 are each correctly labeled, and the 24's €294 EUR figure did NOT bleed into the 25.
